intro.fr: Timesplitters 2 se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Timesplitters 2 can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Free Radical Design sort Timesplitters 2 en 2002.
text.en: Free Radical Design releases Timesplitters 2 in 2002.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub captpurpleheart/ts2-archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Timesplitters 2.
text.en: The GitHub repository captpurpleheart/ts2-archipelago, home of the Timesplitters 2 APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (2 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.0.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (2 versions released).

text.fr: Timesplitters 2 figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Timesplitters 2 is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
